name: Pulau Tioman and Pulau Tulai
source: e-Solat PHG01 "Pulau Tioman". OpenStreetMap (2026-11-03) puts Mukim Tioman and every mismatch point on the island in Rompin, Pahang; ADM1 puts most of the island in Johor.

name: Pulau Seri Buat and Pulau Sembilang
source: OpenStreetMap (2026-11-03) puts 114 of 122 mismatch points on the two islands in Pahang; ADM1 puts them in Johor.

name: Kemaman and Kuantan
source: OpenStreetMap (2026-11-03) puts 3432 of 3636 mismatch points along this border in the district shape's state. Kampung Jabur, Kampung Jabur Hulu, Kampung Jabor Hilir, Kampung Bukit Rambutan, Kampung Durian, Kampung Cina, Kongsi Dua, Kampong Chendar and Kampong Geliga Besar are in Kemaman, Terengganu, per OpenStreetMap; ADM1 puts them in Pahang.

name: Kelantan and Pahang
source: OpenStreetMap (2026-11-03) puts 2560 of 2749 mismatch points along this border in the district shape's state. Pos Penangau is in Kelantan per OpenStreetMap and GeoNames; ADM1 puts it in Pahang.

name: Kelantan and Terengganu
source: OpenStreetMap (2026-11-03) puts 700 of 803 mismatch points along this border in the district shape's state.

name: Pahang and Perak
source: OpenStreetMap (2026-11-03) puts 753 of 831 mismatch points along this border in the district shape's state.

name: Kedah and Perak
source: OpenStreetMap (2026-11-03) puts 361 of 554 mismatch points along this border in the district shape's state. Around Kampung Lembah Baharu, state_borders.csv follows ADM1.

name: Kedah and Perlis
source: OpenStreetMap (2026-11-03) puts 160 of 202 mismatch points along this border in the district shape's state. Kampong Lubok Gokgek and Kampong Padang Tok Kuning are in Perlis per OpenStreetMap and GeoNames; ADM1 puts them in Kedah.

name: Melaka and Negeri Sembilan
source: Kota Simpang is in Melaka per OpenStreetMap (2026-11-03) and GeoNames; ADM1 puts it in Negeri Sembilan. OpenStreetMap puts 14 of 25 mismatch points along this border in the ADM1 state.

name: Kedah and Seberang Perai
source: Kampung Tiga Ratus Kaki is in Kedah per OpenStreetMap (2026-11-03) and GeoNames; ADM1 puts it in Penang. OpenStreetMap puts 8 of 12 mismatch points along this border in the district shape's state.

name: Sabah-Sarawak-Kalimantan tri-point
source: Not an ADM1 error. The national border keeps the ADM2 line, which meets the ADM1 Sabah-Sarawak line 1.4 km from the ADM1 tri-point, so a wedge of about 0.3 km2 of Sabah resolves to SWK01. GeoNames has no place there.
